pairs.target: chūmén nàtiān , tǎ wéi bǎ shuǐhú hé bǐng dài fàngzài shūdài liǎngbiān , hái gé le yíjiàn wàiyī .
pairs.english: On the day of the outing, Tavi put his water flask and bread bag on opposite sides of his book bag, with a coat between them.
pairs.hanzi: 出门那天，塔维把水壶和饼袋放在书袋两边，还隔了一件外衣。

pairs.target: pà wò kàn tā fānláifùqù dì chá , wèn tā shìbushì dǎsuàn bǎ bǐng yǎnghuó .
pairs.english: Watching him check repeatedly, Pavo asked if he planned to keep the bread alive.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃看他翻来覆去地查，问他是不是打算把饼养活。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu jiěshì , zhī bǎ hú sāi yòu àn jǐn le yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't explain, merely pressing the stopper firmly once more.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有解释，只把壶塞又按紧了一次。

pairs.target: nài lěi tāmen tiān méi liàng biàn zǒu le , běi gōng fāng tuō ménfáng liú le jù huà , shuō yǐ shàngchē , méi gǎi xíngchéng .
pairs.english: Nerai and Cendu had left before dawn. The north workshop left word with the gatekeeper: they were aboard the cart, with no itinerary change.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾他们天没亮便走了，北工坊托门房留了句话，说已上车，没改行程。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zài xīmén diǎn qí jiǔgè rén , lìng yǒu yíwèi bèi mùxiāng de luó shīfu tóngháng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey counted all nine at the west gate; Master Luo accompanied them with a wooden tool chest on his back.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师在西门点齐九个人，另有一位背木箱的罗师傅同行。

pairs.target: tā shì tì jiùzhàn xiū péngzǐ de gōngjiàng , zuótiānxiàwǔ zǒu guòlái quèrèn le lùkuàng .
pairs.english: He was the craftsperson repairing the old station's shelter and had walked over yesterday afternoon to check the route.
pairs.hanzi: 他是替旧站修棚子的工匠，昨天下午走过来确认了路况。

pairs.target: xiàshān zǒu jiù chēdào , huílái zǒu shàngmiàn de bùqiáo , zhènghǎo rào yìquān .
pairs.english: They would go down by the old cart road and return by the upper footbridge, making a circuit.
pairs.hanzi: 下山走旧车道，回来走上面的步桥，正好绕一圈。

pairs.target: kāishǐ nàduàn lù hěn kuān , néng kànjiàn shí miàn bèi chēlún mó chū de liǎngtiáo qiǎn cáo .
pairs.english: The first stretch was broad, with two shallow wheel-worn grooves visible in the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 开始那段路很宽，能看见石面被车轮磨出的两条浅槽。

pairs.target: zǒuguò dìsāngè jíwān , tǎ wéi cái fāxiàn tāmen yòu dào le gāngcái nà piàn càidì xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: After the third sharp turn, Tavi discovered they were below the same vegetable plot again.
pairs.hanzi: 走过第三个急弯，塔维才发现他们又到了刚才那片菜地下面。

pairs.target: gé zhe ǎiqiáng , yígè lǎorén réng zài fāntǔ , chútou luòxià de shēngyīn bǐ shuōhuàshēng qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Beyond a low wall, an old man was still turning the soil; his hoe struck more clearly than voices carried.
pairs.hanzi: 隔着矮墙，一个老人仍在翻土，锄头落下的声音比说话声清楚。

pairs.target: yīwén ná lùxiàn dān bǐ le bàntiān , shuō zìjǐ gāngcái yǐwéi yǐjīng zǒu chūqù hěn yuǎn .
pairs.english: Iven compared the route sheet for ages, saying he'd thought they'd gone a long way already.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文拿路线单比了半天，说自己刚才以为已经走出去很远。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǐzhe shānshàng yídào xìxìde héngxiàn , gàosù tā huíchéng búyòng zài rào zhèxiē wān .
pairs.english: Mira pointed to a thin horizontal line on the mountain, telling him they wouldn't need those turns coming back.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉指着山上一道细细的横线，告诉他回程不用再绕这些弯。

pairs.target: nàshí tǎ wéi hái méi bǎ nàtiáo xiàn dàngchéng zìjǐ yào zǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi hadn't yet understood that line as somewhere his own feet would go.
pairs.hanzi: 那时塔维还没把那条线当成自己要走的地方。

pairs.target: jiù zhuǎnyùnzhàn bìng bù kōng . hòuchē péng xià jǐ zhe càikuāng hé bāofú , liǎnggè háizi ná yì jié máshéng shuānzhe mùlún wán .
pairs.english: The old transfer station wasn't empty. Vegetable baskets and bundles crowded the waiting shelter; two children played with a wooden wheel tied to a length of hemp rope.
pairs.hanzi: 旧转运站并不空。候车棚下挤着菜筐和包袱，两个孩子拿一截麻绳拴着木轮玩。

pairs.target: péng hòu de gāojià tíng le jiùchē , xīn xiū de huò tái què zài lìngyìbiān ,
pairs.english: An old cart stood on the raised frame behind the shelter, while the new freight platform was on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 棚后的高架停了旧车，新修的货台却在另一边，

pairs.target: zhuāngxiè de rén rào zhe tāmen zǒu , shuí yě méi yīnwèi lái le xuéshēng biàn tíngxià shǒulǐ de huó .
pairs.english: The loading crews moved around the students; nobody stopped working just because they had arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 装卸的人绕着他们走，谁也没因为来了学生便停下手里的活。

pairs.target: luó shīfu xiān dài tāmen jiàn guǎn péngzǐ de duàn yí .
pairs.english: Master Luo first took them to Auntie Duan, who looked after the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅先带他们见管棚子的段姨。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yibǎ sàozhou nuókāi , téngchū gē mùxiāng de wèizhì , wèn tāmen tú yào huà duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: She moved a broom to make room for the tool chest and asked how long the drawings would take.
pairs.hanzi: 她把一把扫帚挪开，腾出搁木箱的位置，问他们图要画多久。

pairs.target: " xiān liáng , huíqù gǎi . gǎi hǎo zài sònglái . " wéi lǎoshī shuō .
pairs.english: “Measure first, revise back at school, then bring the revised plans,” Instructor Vey said.
pairs.hanzi: “先量，回去改。改好再送来。”维老师说。

pairs.target: duàn yí diǎntóu , méi shuō shénme hǎotīnghuà , zhuǎnshēn bǎ yígè háizi cóng chēlún dǐxià jiào chūlái .
pairs.english: Auntie Duan nodded without compliments and turned to call a child out from under a wheel.
pairs.hanzi: 段姨点头，没说什么好听话，转身把一个孩子从车轮底下叫出来。

pairs.target: nà háizi gēnběn méi zuānjìn zhēn chē xiàmiàn , zhǐshì zài jiù lúnzǐ hòumiàn cáng shéng , kě tā háishì děng tā guòlái le cái zǒu .
pairs.english: He hadn't crawled under a real cart at all, merely hiding rope behind an old wheel, but she waited for him to come over before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 那孩子根本没钻进真车下面，只是在旧轮子后面藏绳，可她还是等他过来了才走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé mǐlā fùzé péngzǐ kàoshān de yícè , yīwén jìshù . luò héng gēn lìngwài liǎng rén liáng wàicè .
pairs.english: Tavi and Mira took the mountainside of the shelter, with Iven recording. Lohen and two others measured the outer side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和米拉负责棚子靠山的一侧，伊文记数。洛衡跟另外两人量外侧。

pairs.target: luó shīfu bǎ ruǎnshéng , zhíchǐ hé jǐgēn zuò jìhào de mùpiàn fāgěi tāmen , jiào tāmen bié wǎng chéngzhòng de mùtou shàng luàn kè .
pairs.english: Master Luo handed out cord, rulers, and wooden marking slips, telling them not to carve randomly into load-bearing wood.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅把软绳、直尺和几根做记号的木片发给他们，叫他们别往承重的木头上乱刻。

pairs.target: mǐ lālā zhí shéng , tǎ wéi bǎ qǐdiǎn tiē zài zhùjiǎo .
pairs.english: Mira pulled the cord straight, and Tavi held its beginning at the foot of a post.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拉直绳，塔维把起点贴在柱脚。

pairs.target: yīwén dūnxiàlái rèn chǐ shàng de xiǎogé , xiān bàocuò le yígè shù , zìjǐ yòu gǎidiào .
pairs.english: Iven crouched to read the small ruler divisions, reported one wrong number, then corrected himself.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蹲下来认尺上的小格，先报错了一个数，自己又改掉。

pairs.target: tāmen liáng le liǎngbiàn , zhǐ shàng zhōngyú yǒu le sìgēn zhùzi de jùlí .
pairs.english: They measured twice, finally setting down the distances between the four posts.
pairs.hanzi: 他们量了两遍，纸上终于有了四根柱子的距离。

pairs.target: péngdǐng kàoshān de jiǎoluò liú zhe yípiàn jiù shuǐyìn . mǐlā shùnzhe tā huà le jiàntóu , zài cǎotú shàng bǎ yánkǒu wǎng wàiyán .
pairs.english: An old water stain marked the roof's mountain-facing corner. Mira drew an arrow along it and extended the eave on her sketch.
pairs.hanzi: 棚顶靠山的角落留着一片旧水印。米拉顺着它画了箭头，在草图上把檐口往外延。

pairs.target: " duō shēn yìdiǎn , xiàmiàn jiù lín bù zhe . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “A little farther out, and people underneath won't get wet,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “多伸一点，下面就淋不着。”她说。

pairs.target: yígè bèi càikuāng de nǚrén zhènghǎo cóng pángbiān guòlái .
pairs.english: Just then a woman carrying a vegetable basket passed beside them.
pairs.hanzi: 一个背菜筐的女人正好从旁边过来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ cháng biǎndàn shùqǐ , cèshēn chuānguò liǎnggēn zhùzi zhījiān , biǎndàn tóu jīhū cā zhe mǐlā xīn huà de nàge wèizhì .
pairs.english: She lifted her long carrying pole upright and edged between two posts; its tip almost brushed the position Mira had just drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 她把长扁担竖起，侧身穿过两根柱子之间，扁担头几乎擦着米拉新画的那个位置。

alignment.english: lifted her long carrying pole upright

pairs.target: duàn yí kànjiàn tú , shēnshǒu zài zhǐ shàng bǐ le yíxià .
pairs.english: Auntie Duan saw the drawing and used her hand to indicate a distance on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 段姨看见图，伸手在纸上比了一下。

pairs.target: " wǎng zhèbiān shēn , biǎndàn jiù zhuǎn bú guòlái le . yǔtiān rén gèng duō , bùnéng dōu jiào tāmen zài wàimiàn xiè . "
pairs.english: “Extend it this way and the poles won't turn. More people come when it rains; we can't make everyone unload outside.”
pairs.hanzi: “往这边伸，扁担就转不过来了。雨天人更多，不能都叫他们在外面卸。”

pairs.target: mǐlā de bǐ tíngzhù le . tā kàn yìyǎn wūdǐng , yòu kàn yìyǎn nà nǚrén jiānshàng lè chū de shēnhén , bǎ yán chūqù de xiàn cādiào yíbàn .
pairs.english: Mira's pen stopped. She looked at the roof, then at the deep marks on the woman's shoulders, and erased half her extension.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的笔停住了。她看一眼屋顶，又看一眼那女人肩上勒出的深痕，把延出去的线擦掉一半。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā huì chóngxīn wèn gāi huà zài nǎér , tā què shōuqǐ bǐ , xiān gēnzhe kàn le sāngè rén zěnme jìn péng .
pairs.english: Tavi thought she would ask where to draw it instead, but she put away her pen and watched three people enter the shelter first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为她会重新问该画在哪儿，她却收起笔，先跟着看了三个人怎么进棚。

pairs.target: dìèrgè rén bèi de shì ǎi kuāng , dìsāngè rén liǎngtóu tiāo huò , zhuǎnshēn yòng de dìfāng guǒrán bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: The second carried a low basket; the third had loads at both ends of a pole. They really did need different turning spaces.
pairs.hanzi: 第二个人背的是矮筐，第三个人两头挑货，转身用的地方果然不一样。

pairs.target: " wǒ dé bǎ zhèlǐ yě liáng shàng . " tā shuō , zhǐzhe zhùzi wàitou .
pairs.english: “I need to measure here too,” she said, pointing outside the posts.
pairs.hanzi: “我得把这里也量上。”她说，指着柱子外头。

pairs.target: tāmen zhèng xiǎng lāshéng , pénglǐ de rén hūrán wǎng wài yǒng .
pairs.english: Just as they were about to stretch the cord, people suddenly poured out of the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 他们正想拉绳，棚里的人忽然往外涌。

pairs.target: xīnhuò táishàng de chē dào le , děng chē de nuó bāo , xièhuò de yào jìnlái , ruǎnshéng héng zài zhōngjiān , lìkè àishì .
pairs.english: A cart had reached the new platform. Waiting passengers moved their bundles, unloaders wanted in, and their cord across the middle was instantly in the way.
pairs.hanzi: 新货台上的车到了，等车的挪包，卸货的要进来，软绳横在中间，立刻碍事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān shōu le zìjǐ de nà tóu . mǐlā tuì dào zhù hòu , yīwén bǎ jiābǎn jǔ gāo , xiǎnxiē ràng yìbǎ càiyè sǎo dào liǎnshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi gathered his end first. Mira stepped behind a post, and Iven raised his clipboard, narrowly avoiding a brush of vegetable leaves across his face.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先收了自己的那头。米拉退到柱后，伊文把夹板举高，险些让一把菜叶扫到脸上。

pairs.target: sāngè rén tiēzhe zhùzi zhàn le yíhuìer , shuí yě méi néng bǎ gāngcái nàtiáo xiàn huà wán .
pairs.english: The three stayed pressed beside the posts for a while, none able to finish the line they had begun.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人贴着柱子站了一会儿，谁也没能把刚才那条线画完。

pairs.target: děng rén zǒukāi , tǎ wéi wèn duàn yí shénme shíhòu bǐjiào kōng .
pairs.english: When the crowd moved on, Tavi asked Auntie Duan when it was quieter.
pairs.hanzi: 等人走开，塔维问段姨什么时候比较空。

pairs.target: tā shuō wǔfàn qián yǒu yìxiǎo huìer , jiào tāmen xiān qù liáng hòumiàn de duǎn qiáng , bié dǎng zhe zhè tàng chē .
pairs.english: She said there was a short lull before lunch. They should measure the low wall behind first and let this cart through.
pairs.hanzi: 她说午饭前有一小会儿，叫他们先去量后面的短墙，别挡着这趟车。

pairs.target: luó shīfu tīngjiàn le , bǎ zìjǐ de mùxiāng yě tídào qiánggēn . búshì zhǐyǒu xuéshēng yào rànglù .
pairs.english: Hearing her, Master Luo moved his tool chest against the wall too. Students weren't the only ones who had to make room.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅听见了，把自己的木箱也提到墙根。不是只有学生要让路。

pairs.target: duǎn qiáng páng yǒu yìtái tíngyòng de juàn suǒ jī . tiějià hěn gāo , xiàmiàn liú zhe zhǎizhǎide jiǎnxiū kǒu , kǒu biān guà le mùpái .
pairs.english: Beside the low wall stood a disused cable winch, its iron frame tall above a narrow maintenance opening with a wooden notice at its edge.
pairs.hanzi: 短墙旁有一台停用的卷索机。铁架很高，下面留着窄窄的检修口，口边挂了木牌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià dú , rènchū " bānshǒu " liǎnggè zì , hòumiàn de zì què móhu le .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to read it. He recognized the word “wrench,” but the characters after it were faded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下读，认出“扳手”两个字，后面的字却模糊了。

pairs.target: yīwén còu guòlái niàn : " chūlái yǐqián , bǎ bānshǒu dàizǒu . "
pairs.english: Iven leaned close and read, “Bring your wrench out before you leave.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文凑过来念：“出来以前，把扳手带走。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le . tā yuányǐwéi jiù jīqì shàng de páizi zǒngděi xiě xiē yánsù de jìnlìng , méixiǎngdào yě yǒurén gānwán huó bǎ gōngjù luò zài lǐtou .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed. He had thought notices on old machines must carry solemn prohibitions; apparently people also finished work and left their tools inside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了。他原以为旧机器上的牌子总得写些严肃的禁令，没想到也有人干完活把工具落在里头。

pairs.target: luó shīfu shuō zhè tái zǎo chāidiào le zhǔ suǒ , zhī liú zhe gěi xuétú kàn , bùnéngzìjǐ zuānjìnqù .
pairs.english: Master Luo said its main cable had been removed long ago; it was kept for apprentices to study, and they mustn't crawl inside on their own.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅说这台早拆掉了主索，只留着给学徒看，不能自己钻进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi biàn bǎ nǎodài suōhuílái , gé zhe kǒuzǐ kànjiàn lǐmiàn yíkuài móliàng de mùbǎn , shì rén fú zhe xiū dōngxī shí diàn xiōngkǒu de .
pairs.english: Tavi drew his head back. Through the opening he saw a polished wooden board where workers rested their chests while repairing things.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维便把脑袋缩回来，隔着口子看见里面一块磨亮的木板，是人伏着修东西时垫胸口的。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ yǎnqián zhè tái dàngchéng zìjǐ bèi fāxiàn de nà tái . zhèlǐ lí tā de lái chù duō yuǎn , tā hái bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: He didn't mistake this machine for the one he had been found in. How far this place lay from his origins, he still didn't know.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把眼前这台当成自己被发现的那台。这里离他的来处多远，他还不知道。

pairs.target: kě nà kuài mùbǎn shàng quèshí yā guò rén de shēntǐ , biānshàng háiyǒu bǔguò de lièfèng , jīqì lǐmiàn hūrán búzài zhǐshì yígè kōngdòng .
pairs.english: But human bodies had pressed against that board, and a crack along its edge had been mended. Suddenly the machine's interior was more than an empty hole.
pairs.hanzi: 可那块木板上确实压过人的身体，边上还有补过的裂缝，机器里面忽然不再只是一个空洞。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài qiángbiān hǎn tā , yào bǎ chǐzi de lìngyìtóu dìguòqù .
pairs.english: Mira called him from the wall to pass over the other end of the ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在墙边喊他，要把尺子的另一头递过去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qǐshēn , pāidiào xī shàng de huī , huítóu yòu kàn le yìyǎn mùpái .
pairs.english: Tavi stood, brushed the dust off his knees, and looked back at the notice once more.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维起身，拍掉膝上的灰，回头又看了一眼木牌。

pairs.target: dào wǔfàn qián , tāmen zhōngyú děngdào le nà yìxiǎo duàn kòngxián .
pairs.english: Before lunch, they finally caught that brief lull.
pairs.hanzi: 到午饭前，他们终于等到了那一小段空闲。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài péngwài , jǔ zhe shōu hǎo de shéng , děng zuìhòu yífù biǎndàn zhuǎnchūqù , cái cháo tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Mira stood outside the shelter with the gathered cord, waiting for the last carrying pole to turn out before nodding to him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在棚外，举着收好的绳，等最后一副扁担转出去，才朝他点头。
